goal: To create an AI tutor for the classroom that can adapt the difficulty of questions based on the student's level of frustration.
core_capabilities: Adjust the difficulty of questions based on detected frustration.
main_components: Frustration Detection Module: Identifies student frustration through inputs such as facial expressions, voice tone, or interaction patterns.
Difficulty Adjustment Engine: Changes the difficulty of questions in real-time based on the student's frustration level.
assumptions: Students can interact with the AI tutor in real-time.
open_questions: What specific indicators will be used to detect student frustration?
How will the system evaluate the effectiveness of its question difficulty adjustments on learning outcomes?
